description: Measured object positions. For each packet frame: the screen bounds of each visible private key, request capsule, certificate card, key container and key module, projected from the evaluated 3D scene through the film camera. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in pixels of a 960x540 frame, origin top left. 'in_frame' is true when the box overlaps the frame. 'depth_m' is the distance in front of the lens. Objects at zero scale (not yet formed, consumed or hidden) are not listed. These are measurements only: occlusion is not measured, so check each box against the frame image.
